note: Judged 2026-10-21 over current tags, units and records. Quote verified in RFC 5392 Section 3.3.1 ('The Remote AS Number sub-TLV is REQUIRED in a Link TLV that advertises an inter-AS TE link'). The positive checks that every originated inter-AS Link TLV carries sub-TLV 21 (record on buildInterASTELink). The negative checks that a received one without it is skipped and leaves no TED entry (record on validateReceivedTELink).
